title: OT Connector Command Message
description: Request/result messages on the thin-edge command topics the connector answers (§6): te/device/<device>///cmd/<command type>/<id>, or te/device/main/service/<service>/cmd/<command type>/<id> for a management verb addressed to one instance (retained). The 'init' state is set by the requester; the connector advances the state machine on the same topic.

point.description: Target point id. Required for the 'write' verb.

value.description: Logical value for a write, in ENGINEERING units — the same units a sample's 'value' carries (§4.2). The runtime inverts the point's linear transform before the module encodes it, and echoes the engineering value back in the result. For datatype 'bytes' it is the hex string written verbatim (§1: there is no separate 'raw' request field).

target.description: Management 'set-config' verb: configuration section to patch ('connector', 'mqtt', 'connection', or 'device:<name>').

config.description: Management 'set-config' verb: deep-merged patch applied to the selected target section.

device.description: Management verbs: a device definition object (for 'define-device') or a device name string (for 'remove-device').

writes.description: 'write-batch' verb request: the writes to apply in order, each a {point, value|raw} object.

points.description: 'write-batch' executing transition: the points about to be written.

results.description: 'write-batch' result: one entry per attempted write, in order (the failing write is the last entry of a failed batch).

origin.description: Opaque requester correlation data. Never interpreted by the connector, but echoed verbatim into every transition it publishes for that command: the topic is retained and holds one message, so the result overwrites the request, and a consumer that restarts replays the terminal state alone.
